delete.content: This removes the encrypted model configuration and anonymous session. Meetings saved in this browser stay untouched.
delete.title: Clear the model configuration?

dialog.description: Add your own provider key to continue. Convergene never supplies a shared model key.
dialog.title: Connect a model provider

errors.INPUT_INVALID: Check the provider and API key fields, then try again.
errors.ORIGIN_INVALID: This request could not be verified. Reload Convergene and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED: Authentication failed. Check the API key and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_CONFIG_INVALID: The saved configuration can no longer be used. Enter the key again.
errors.PROVIDER_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE: Model configuration storage is temporarily unavailable. Your local meetings are still safe.
errors.PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The approved model is unavailable for this account. Check the provider account or try the other provider.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: The provider is limiting requests. Wait a moment, then test again.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The provider could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many configuration attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

feedback.deleteSuccess: Model configuration cleared. Local meetings were not changed.
feedback.saveSuccess: Model configuration saved. The API key is hidden from now on.
feedback.testSuccess: Connection verified. You can save this configuration.

form.description: Test the key first. A successful test unlocks saving without showing the key again.
form.keyHelp: The field clears after every test or save attempt. A verified key stays only in temporary page memory until you save or change it.
form.title: Add your model configuration

page.description: Connect one approved provider, verify the key, and keep model access separate from meeting data.
page.metadataDescription: Securely configure a StepFun or SiliconFlow model key for Convergene.
page.title: Model connection

privacy.encrypted: The server stores the API key encrypted and never shows it again.
privacy.expiry: The configuration expires after 30 inactive days.
privacy.meetings: Meeting content stays in this browser and is not stored by the Convergene backend.
privacy.provider: An AI action sends only the necessary context to the provider you choose.
privacy.title: Data boundary

validation.keyTooLong: The API key is too long.
validation.keyWhitespace: The API key cannot contain spaces or line breaks.
